issue.title: Repair the corrupt SASE artifact JSON files that keep agent index verify false
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-ez.4 during epic sase-ez (plans:202608/revert_bead_reprefix_epic.md) and re-verified by sase-ez.land on 2026-08-03.

'sase agent index verify -j' returns ok=false purely because four artifact JSON files under the gh_sase-org__sase project fail to parse. Re-verified output on 2026-08-03: {"corrupt_rows": 4, "extra_rows": 0, "indexed_rows": 6262, "missing_rows": 2, "source_rows": 6264, "stale_rows": 3712, "ok": false}. The four files are:

- /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202607/19/20260719084609/prompt_step_gh__diff.json
- /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202607/19/20260719084609/workflow_state.json
- /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/fix-hook/20260719084348/done.json
- /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/fix-hook/20260719084413/done.json

All four are from 2026-07-19 and survive a clean index rebuild, so this is bad data on disk rather than an index bug. Impact: verify can never report clean, so it is useless as a health signal and any automation gated on it stays red.

Scope: inspect the four files, then either repair them if the intended content is recoverable or quarantine them so verify can distinguish unrecoverable historical corruption from a live problem. Decide and document which of the two the tool should do in general. Also confirm whether the 2 missing_rows seen in the 2026-08-03 run are a separate issue.
